worldcombat.skill.geomancy.summary: Plant into the earth and draw on its ley energy: a ground ring opens underfoot and the user stands rooted, gathering power; on the next beat the ring erupts and the energy surges back, raising Sp. Atk, Sp. Def and Speed together. If the user is put to sleep or frozen while gathering, the energy collapses and nothing is gained.
worldcombat.skill.geomancy.use.0: Gather at a safe distance before a fight
worldcombat.skill.geomancy.use.1: Trade a standing channel for three permanent boosts
worldcombat.skill.geomancy.use.2: Turn the ground underfoot into a ring and mark the battlefield
worldcombat.skill.geomancy.description.0: The second beat raises Sp. Atk, Sp. Def and Speed by %1$s each.
worldcombat.skill.geomancy.description.1: The first beat channels for %1$s, the ring spans %2$s blocks and about %3$s motes rise; the user stands rooted and cannot act during this time.
worldcombat.skill.geomancy.description.2: Ley energy rises at %1$s and the ring lingers on the ground for %2$s after the burst.
worldcombat.skill.geomancy.description.3: %1$s wind-up, %2$s recovery, %3$s cooldown. Sleep or freeze during the channel collapses the energy and gains nothing.
worldcombat.skill.geomancy.timing: A self move with %1$s blocks of range; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.geomancy.growth.0: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.geomancy.growth.1: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens further to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.geomancy.preference.ai: Geomancy is considered only against a threat within this distance; larger means starting earlier at longer range.
A threat closer than this makes the companion give up the channel and fight; the user cannot move while gathering, so larger is more cautious.
